notes: XNA 4.0 games and their open reimplementations: FNA ships as FNA.dll beside the game (https://fna-xna.github.io/docs/1%3A-Setting-Up-FNA/), MonoGame as MonoGame.Framework.dll (https://docs.monogame.net/articles/getting_started/packaging_games.html), and an XNA build references Microsoft.Xna.Framework*.dll. A game built against XNA itself often ships no framework DLL (the redistributable installs it), so the compiled content tree is the fallback tell: .xnb is the XNA content pipeline's output format, loaded from Content/ (https://docs.monogame.net/articles/getting_to_know/whatis/content_pipeline/). No enginehost plugin yet.
